name: Shove Aside
body:
Shove Aside (Ex)
Source Cohorts and Companions pg. 27
When you and an adjacent ally are both in the area of an attack that requires a saving throw, you can take a –4 penalty on your saving throw to grant your ally a +4 bonus on his saving throw. You lose the evasion ability against this attack. If you have improved evasion, it is reduced to evasion for this attack instead. A rogue must have evasion to select this rogue talent.
